rec.name: Cart Reservation Label (Static Notice / Countdown Timer)
rec.status: Built — launched (Focal theme; per-theme adaptation needed for other themes)

what.text: A configurable label shown in the cart drawer and cart page with two modes. Mode 1 (static scarcity) shows a fixed notice such as "Your items are not reserved in the cart" next to a small icon. Mode 2 (dynamic scarcity) shows a countdown message such as "Your cart is reserved for (time) minutes" with a live mm:ss timer. The timer duration is set in minutes (the ticket cites 1–120). When the timer expires, the countdown label is hidden and the static label is shown again.

why.text: The static notice implies that stock is not held, which creates loss aversion and nudges shoppers to check out sooner. The countdown adds a time-bound deadline to finish the purchase, which triggers urgency and reduces cart abandonment and dithering. Placing it right in the cart puts the pressure at the decision point. Overly aggressive or fake timers can erode trust, so the duration should be realistic.

how.text: Add a Liquid snippet (cart-reservation) that renders two label blocks, a static one and a timer one. The timer text contains the placeholder "(time)", which is replaced with a span that JavaScript updates. Settings live in theme settings (settings_schema.json): icon (HTML/SVG), static text (richtext), timer text, minutes, text colour, font size, alignment, background colour and border style. Inject the minutes value as a JS variable in theme.liquid. In theme.js, reservationTimer() runs a 1-second interval against a start/end timestamp stored in localStorage and updates the .time element. checkCart() resets the end time when a product is added while the cart is empty (no #mini-cart-form). Hook reservationTimer() into the cart drawer re-render (CartDrawer._rerenderCart) and checkCart() into the add-to-cart handler (ProductForm._onSubmit) in the Focal theme. Render the snippet in the cart with {% render "cart-reservation" %}. Other themes (e.g. Impulse) need their own hook points because each theme's cart differs.

items: Reservation icon (pasted SVG/HTML; icon colour is only changeable by editing the SVG, with a colour picker planned for v1.1)
Static label text (rich text), e.g. "Deine Artikel werden im Warenkorb nicht reserviert"
Timer label text with (time) placeholder, e.g. "Dein Warenkorb ist für (time) Minuten reserviert"

dependencies.text: No metafields. The ticket flags it as not installable by non-devs. It needs theme file edits: a new snippet, a script variable in theme.liquid, JS in theme.js, theme-settings schema entries, and hooks in the cart drawer and add-to-cart code. Built on the Focal theme; other themes (e.g. Impulse) need custom hook placement. Relies on browser localStorage for the timer state. Behaviour note: in the timer-label field the static text is shown when no timer is wanted or after expiry. Per the comments, the first (static) field applies when no timer is desired. In the code, the timer text field must be non-empty for the countdown to render.
